title: Lulu Draws a Picture | Bedtime Story for Kids
description:
Lulu has paper and crayons. She draws a smiling sun, green grass and a red flower.
Bunny hops in: what is that? Wait and see! Lulu draws a little bunny and a heart.
Ta-da! It is a picture for Bunny. A big, warm hug, then good night under the moon.
A calm bedtime story about making something kind for a friend, for children aged 3 to 6.
